film.title: How does the return of protons produce ATP?
film.look: Continuous 16:9 emerald-leaf journey, golden volumetric light aur teal shadows; chloroplast jade, membrane dark-green, lumen pale turquoise, stroma ivory-teal, proton pump copper; ATP synthase right par, amber CF0 ring, silver stalk aur violet six-lobed CF1 head; realistic molecular structures aur khula aqueous workspace.

shots.title: From sunlight to usable energy
shots.key: The return of accumulated H+ helps make ATP.

visual.image_prompt: 16:9 photoreal macro of an emerald living leaf, golden sunlight, teal shaded natural background, realistic veins and translucent tissue. Sunlit patch at 60,50 leads into the leaf interior. No microscopic objects. Leave upper left open for light movement and labels.

sentences.roman: When protons accumulated in the leaf flow back through a special route, how is ATP made?
sentences.voice: When protons accumulated in the leaf flow back through a special route, how is ATP made?
sentences.hinglish: Patte mein jama protons ek khaas raaste se wapas niklein, toh ATP kaise ban jaata hai?

sentences.roman: Let us find out. First, recall that the energy of light reaching this leaf drives photosynthesis.
sentences.voice: Let us find out. First, recall that the energy of light reaching this leaf drives photosynthesis.
sentences.beyond: Light energy ka prerequisite recall hai.
sentences.hinglish: Aaiye jaante hain. Pehle yaad kijiye ki is patte mein aati light ki energy photosynthesis ko chalati hai.

sentences.roman: Now let us go inside this illuminated part.
sentences.voice: Now let us go inside this illuminated part.
sentences.hinglish: Ab isi roshni wale hisse ke andar chalte hain.

shots.title: Inside the cell
shots.key: The machinery for making ATP is found in the chloroplast.

visual.image_prompt: Scientific transparent cross-section inside the same emerald leaf patch, 16:9, soft volumetric sunlight and deep teal shadows. One mesophyll cell dominates with translucent cream wall, large clear vacuole and peripheral cytoplasm. Several realistic jade double-envelope chloroplasts; target at 64,55 with faint olive-gold internal stacks. No proteins or molecules visible. Open space above target for light animation and labels.

sentences.roman: Now we are inside a mesophyll cell of the leaf, with chloroplasts along its edges.
sentences.voice: Now we are inside a mesophyll cell of the leaf, with chloroplasts along its edges.
sentences.beyond: Cell se chloroplast tak spatial context dete hain.
sentences.hinglish: Ab hum leaf ki mesophyll cell ke andar hain, jiske kinaare par chloroplasts maujood hain.

sentences.roman: Look, light reaches this chloroplast. Let us take a closer look inside at the place where ATP is made.
sentences.voice: Look, light reaches this chloroplast. Let us take a closer look inside at the place where ATP is made.
sentences.beyond: Light aur organelle ka spatial bridge hai.
sentences.hinglish: Dekhiye, light is chloroplast tak pahunchti hai; aaiye, isi ke andar ATP banne ki jagah ko paas se samajhte hain.

shots.title: The closed thylakoid
shots.key: The lumen is inside the thylakoid, and the stroma is outside.

visual.image_prompt: 16:9 realistic scientific cutaway inside selected sage-green chloroplast. Double envelope surrounds ivory-teal fluid stroma and dark-green flattened thylakoid sacs stacked into grana and connected by stromal lamellae. Continuous enclosing membranes; optical transparency reveals pale turquoise lumen without physical openings. Accessible unstacked thylakoid at 64,58. No individual proteins or molecular beads at this scale. Golden light, teal depth, empty upper right for overlays.

sentences.roman: Inside the chloroplast, this thylakoid is a closed, flattened sac, with the lumen inside and the fluid stroma outside.
sentences.voice: Inside the chloroplast, this thylakoid is a closed, flattened sac, with the lumen inside and the fluid stroma outside.
sentences.beyond: Band thaili ki analogy se compartments samjhate hain.
sentences.hinglish: Chloroplast ke andar yeh thylakoid band chapti thaili hai, jiske andar lumen aur bahar fluid stroma hai.

sentences.roman: The work driven by light energy happens on this thylakoid membrane. Now let us move closer to its wall.
sentences.voice: The work driven by light energy happens on this thylakoid membrane. Now let us move closer to its wall.
sentences.beyond: Light reactions ki location ka bridge hai.
sentences.hinglish: Light ki energy se chalne wala kaam isi thylakoid membrane par hota hai; ab iski deewar ke paas chalte hain.

shots.title: Energy of the gradient
shots.key: The pump accumulates H+; the gradient holds energy for making ATP.

visual.image_prompt: 16:9 molecular structural cutaway of the selected closed unstacked thylakoid sac. Dark-green lipid bilayer across y60, curved sealed ends and lower sac boundary visible; pale turquoise lumen below, ivory-teal stroma above. Copper cytochrome b6f proton-translocating complex left at 22,60. ATP synthase right at 72,60 with amber membrane CF0 ring, silver stalk, violet six-lobed CF1 head at 72,32 facing stroma. Transparent intact membrane, realistic structural models, golden light and teal shadows. Empty aqueous compartments for animated H+, no static molecular beads.

sentences.roman: Now we are near the membrane of the closed thylakoid. Why are we so interested in the proton gradient?
sentences.voice: Now we are near the membrane of the closed thylakoid. Why are we so interested in the proton gradient?
sentences.hinglish: Ab band thylakoid ki membrane ke paas hain; aakhir proton gradient mein itni dilchaspi kyun hai?

sentences.roman: The simple answer is that the energy released as the gradient decreases makes ATP, just as water released from a dam does work.
sentences.voice: The simple answer is that the energy released as the gradient decreases makes ATP, just as water released from a dam does work.
sentences.beyond: Baandh se stored energy samjhate hain.
sentences.hinglish: Iska seedha sa jawab hai ki gradient ghatne ki energy se ATP banta hai, jaise baandh se chhootne wala paani kaam karwaata hai.

sentences.roman: Look, the proton pump uses energy to accumulate H+ from the stroma in the lumen, creating a high concentration in the lumen and a proton gradient across the membrane.
sentences.voice: Look, the proton pump uses energy to accumulate H plus from the stroma in the lumen, creating a high concentration in the lumen and a proton gradient across the membrane.
sentences.hinglish: Dekhiye, proton pump energy lagaakar H+ ko stroma se lumen mein jama karta hai, jisse lumen mein high concentration aur membrane ke across proton gradient banta hai.

sentences.roman: Now let us take a closer look at ATP synthase on the right, where these accumulated H+ flow back.
sentences.voice: Now let us take a closer look at ATP synthase on the right, where these accumulated H plus flow back.
sentences.hinglish: Ab daayin taraf ATP synthase ko paas se dekhte hain, jahan yeh jama H+ wapas nikalte hain.

shots.title: Return through CF0
shots.key: CF0 brings H+ into the stroma by facilitated diffusion.

visual.image_prompt: 16:9 closer molecular cutaway inside previous ATP synthase region. Dark-green bilayer y62, pale turquoise lumen below and ivory-teal stroma above. ATP synthase remains right x72: amber CF0 ring embedded at 72,62, realistic stator-ring proton half-channels connect lumen entry 69,69 to stroma exit 78,52; silver central stalk; violet six-lobed CF1 head at 72,29 facing stroma, peripheral stalk. Distinct articulated catalytic clefts, not a rotating whole head. Intact lipid field left around 38,62. Open aqueous approach space left and upper right for ADP, Pi and ATP. Golden volumetric illumination, teal shadows, no text or prepainted molecules.

sentences.roman: Now we are close to ATP synthase. Which route do H+ take to cross the membrane?
sentences.voice: Now we are close to ATP synthase. Which route do H plus take to cross the membrane?
sentences.hinglish: Ab ATP synthase paas hai; H+ membrane ko paar karne ke liye kaunsa raasta lete hain?

sentences.roman: CF0, embedded in the membrane, provides this route. Its transmembrane channel brings H+ from the lumen into the stroma by facilitated diffusion.
sentences.voice: C F 0, embedded in the membrane, provides this route. Its transmembrane channel brings H plus from the lumen into the stroma by facilitated diffusion.
sentences.hinglish: Isme kaam aata hai membrane mein dhansa CF0, jiska transmembrane channel H+ ko lumen se stroma mein facilitated diffusion se laata hai.

sentences.roman: Just as water flows downhill, H+ return down the electrochemical gradient, providing energy for ATP synthesis. F0 is another name for this same part.
sentences.voice: Just as water flows downhill, H plus return down the electrochemical gradient, providing energy for ATP synthesis. F 0 is another name for this same part.
sentences.beyond: Electrochemical downhill flow ko paani ki dhalan se samjhate hain.
sentences.hinglish: Jaise paani dhalan par behta hai, waise H+ electrochemical gradient ke saath lautte hain, jisse ATP synthesis ki energy milti hai; F0 bhi isi hisse ka naam hai.

sentences.roman: The other part of this enzyme, CF1, projects from the outer surface towards the stroma, where we will now see ATP being made.
sentences.voice: The other part of this enzyme, C F 1, projects from the outer surface towards the stroma, where we will now see ATP being made.
sentences.hinglish: Isi enzyme ka doosra hissa CF1 bahari surface par stroma ki taraf nikla hai, jahan ab hum ATP banta dekhenge.

shots.title: Turning stalk, changing shape
shots.key: H+ flow turns the stalk; CF1 makes ATP from ADP and Pi.

visual.image_prompt: 16:9 deeper molecular structural view of the same right-hand ATP synthase x72, preserving surrounding membrane. Dark-green bilayer y64, pale turquoise lumen below, ivory-teal stroma above. Amber CF0 ring 72,64, silver rotor stalk to violet six-lobed CF1 head 72,30, peripheral stator. Show individual catalytic lobes with clearly distinct open and closed clefts and translucent local alternate domain contours indicating physical opening and closing, not whole-head spin. Empty catalytic cleft at 70,30 and product space 90,20. Left membrane region at 38,64 remains visible for subsequent inspection. Golden light, teal depth, no prepainted molecules.

sentences.roman: Now we are close to the catalytic parts of CF1. How does the return of H+ change their shape?
sentences.voice: Now we are close to the catalytic parts of C F 1. How does the return of H plus change their shape?
sentences.hinglish: Ab CF1 ke catalytic hisse paas hain; H+ ki waapsi inki shape kaise badalti hai?

sentences.roman: Look, as H+ return through CF0, the central stalk turns, changing the shape of the catalytic parts of CF1. This is called conformational change.
sentences.voice: Look, as H plus return through C F 0, the central stalk turns, changing the shape of the catalytic parts of C F 1. This is called conformational change.
sentences.beyond: Stalk rotation ko catalytic conformational change se jodte hain.
sentences.hinglish: Dekhiye, CF0 se H+ lautne par central stalk ghoomta hai, jisse CF1 ke catalytic hisse shape badalte hain; isi ko conformational change kehte hain.

sentences.roman: Now ADP and Pi from the stroma come together at this catalytic site, where the enzyme makes energy-packed ATP.
sentences.voice: Now ADP and P i from the stroma come together at this catalytic site, where the enzyme makes energy packed ATP.
sentences.beyond: ADP aur inorganic phosphate ka catalytic meeting dikhate hain.
sentences.hinglish: Ab stroma ke ADP aur Pi isi catalytic site par milte hain, jahan enzyme energy-packed ATP banata hai.

sentences.roman: This happens repeatedly, making several molecules of ATP from ADP and Pi, not just one.
sentences.voice: This happens repeatedly, making several molecules of ATP from ADP and P i, not just one.
sentences.hinglish: Yeh kaam baar-baar hota hai, jisse ADP aur Pi se ATP ke several molecules bante hain, sirf ek nahi.

shots.title: Membrane leak
shots.key: A controlled exit does useful work; an uncontrolled leak wastes energy.

visual.image_prompt: 16:9 closer inspection within left lipid field of previous membrane, retaining right ATP synthase. Dark-green membrane y64, pale turquoise lumen below, ivory-teal stroma above. Clear aqueous tear at 38,64 with ragged lipid edges visibly connects lumen to stroma. Copper proton pump left 18,64. ATP synthase right 76,64 with amber CF0 ring, silver stalk and violet six-lobed CF1 head 76,32 facing stroma. Intact bilayer segment 51 to 65 contrasts with tear. Closed sac boundary remains visible below. Golden illumination, teal shadows, open water for H+ motion; no ATP products painted near inactive CF1.

sentences.roman: Now look at this open leak in the nearby membrane. What will happen if H+ escape through it?
sentences.voice: Now look at this open leak in the nearby membrane. What will happen if H plus escape through it?
sentences.hinglish: Ab paas ki membrane mein yeh khula leak dekhiye; agar H+ yahin se nikal jaayein toh kya hoga?

sentences.roman: In that case, H+ escape through the gap into the stroma, wasting the energy of the gradient without driving ATP synthase, just like a crack in a dam.
sentences.voice: In that case, H plus escape through the gap into the stroma, wasting the energy of the gradient without driving ATP synthase, just like a crack in a dam.
sentences.beyond: Baandh ki daraar se gradient dissipation aur synthase bypass samjhate hain.
sentences.hinglish: Aisa hone par H+ gap se stroma mein nikalte hain, jisse gradient ki energy ATP synthase ko chalaaye bina waste hoti hai, jaise baandh mein daraar pad jaaye.

sentences.roman: So chemiosmosis needs all four: an intact membrane, a proton pump, a proton gradient and ATP synthase. The H+ accumulated by the pump must not leak out.
sentences.voice: So chemiosmosis needs all four, an intact membrane, a proton pump, a proton gradient and ATP synthase. The H plus accumulated by the pump must not leak out.
sentences.beyond: Intact membrane ki functional zaroorat samjhate hain.
sentences.hinglish: Isliye chemiosmosis ko intact membrane, proton pump, proton gradient aur ATP synthase, chaaron chahiye; pump ka jama kiya H+ leak se bachna chahiye.

shots.title: Supply to the stroma
shots.key: ATP supplies energy, and NADPH supplies reducing power.

visual.image_prompt: 16:9 realistic molecular scientific cutaway of an intact neighboring thylakoid and stroma in the same chloroplast, continuing the q14teacher-lines structural set. Dark-green intact bilayer at y78, pale turquoise lumen beneath and ivory-teal stroma above. ATP synthase right x72: amber CF0 at 72,78, silver stalk and violet six-lobed CF1 head at 72,55. Realistic stromal enzymes left, recognizable Rubisco barrel at 30,35 and dispersed biosynthetic enzymes at 34,53, never boxes or a wheel. Open corridors from synthase into enzymes and upper left into stroma, sugar workspace at 16,64. Golden volumetric light, teal shadows, no text or prepainted molecules.

sentences.roman: Now let us enter the stroma in the intact part of this chloroplast. What is the ATP made here used for next?
sentences.voice: Now let us enter the stroma in the intact part of this chloroplast. What is the ATP made here used for next?
sentences.hinglish: Ab isi chloroplast ke intact hisse ke stroma mein aate hain; yahan bana ATP aage kis kaam aata hai?

sentences.roman: The simple answer is that ATP immediately supplies energy to the biosynthetic reactions in the stroma.
sentences.voice: The simple answer is that ATP immediately supplies energy to the biosynthetic reactions in the stroma.
sentences.hinglish: Iska seedha sa jawab hai ki ATP turant stroma ki biosynthetic reactions ko energy supply karta hai.

sentences.roman: Along with it, NADPH made through electron movement also reaches here and provides reducing power for synthesis. Now let us move closer to these enzymes.
sentences.voice: Along with it, NADPH made through electron movement also reaches here and provides reducing power for synthesis. Now let us move closer to these enzymes.
sentences.beyond: ATP ki energy aur NADPH ki reducing power alag karte hain.
sentences.hinglish: Saath hi electron movement se bana NADPH bhi yahin pahunchta hai, jo synthesis ke liye reducing power deta hai; ab in enzymes ke paas chalte hain.

shots.title: From energy to sugar
shots.key: ATP and NADPH are supplied for CO2 fixation and sugar synthesis in the stroma.

visual.image_prompt: 16:9 closer molecular scientific cutaway inside the stromal enzyme field previously at 34,53. Ivory-teal fluid stroma fills frame, dark-green intact thylakoid membrane remains along bottom y90 with pale turquoise lumen beneath. Realistic Rubisco barrel on left at 30,30, individual downstream globular biosynthetic enzymes at 34,55. Preserve left-sided enzyme field. No ATP synthase in this tighter crop. Open aqueous corridors from upper left for CO2 and upper right for ATP and NADPH; empty product space at 16,70. Not boxes or a wheel. Golden volumetric illumination and teal shadows, realistic structural protein models, no text or prepainted molecules.

sentences.roman: Now we are near the enzymes in the stroma. What does the plant finally get from this supply of ATP and NADPH?
sentences.voice: Now we are near the enzymes in the stroma. What does the plant finally get from this supply of ATP and NADPH?
sentences.hinglish: Ab stroma ke enzymes ke paas hain; ATP aur NADPH ki supply se paudhe ko aakhir milta kya hai?

sentences.roman: Look, CO2 is fixed here, and sugars are then made with the help of ATP-NADPH, incorporating the captured energy into food.
sentences.voice: Look, C O 2 is fixed here, and sugars are then made with the help of ATP and NADPH, incorporating the captured energy into food.
sentences.beyond: Sugar mein energy storage ka basic outcome dikhate hain; cycle ke detailed steps nahi.
sentences.hinglish: Dekhiye, CO2 yahan fix hota hai, aur ATP-NADPH ki madad se aage sugars banti hain, jisse pakdi hui energy khane mein judti hai.

sentences.roman: Remember these points from this video: the H+ gradient across an intact membrane decreases through CF0, CF1 makes ATP, and ATP-NADPH drive sugar synthesis.
sentences.voice: Remember these points from this video, the H plus gradient across an intact membrane decreases through C F 0, C F 1 makes ATP, and ATP and NADPH drive sugar synthesis.
sentences.hinglish: Is video se aapko yeh baatein yaad rakhni hain: intact membrane ka H+ gradient CF0 se ghatta hai, CF1 ATP banata hai, aur ATP-NADPH sugar synthesis chalate hain.

question.question: How is ATP made when accumulated protons flow back?
question.hook: Membrane mein ek specific exit khulte hi stored gradient usable energy banne lagta hai.

points.point: ATP synthase ka membrane-embedded CF0 proton channel hai aur CF1 stroma-facing catalytic part hai.
H+ ka lumen se stroma facilitated diffusion CF1 mein conformational change chalaakar ATP synthesis karwata hai.
Chemiosmosis ko intact membrane, proton pump, proton gradient aur ATP synthase chahiye; uncontrolled leak gradient ki energy waste karta hai.
Bane hue ATP aur NADPH stroma mein CO2 fixation aur sugar synthesis ko supply hote hain.

film.showing_moment: H+ CF0 se stroma mein lautte hain aur CF1 shape badalkar ADP-Pi se ATP banata hai.

game_stage.idea: Membrane mein CF0 aur stroma side CF1 lagao; gradient release karke ATP banao, leak lagane par output girta dekho.
